h1: ♇ Pluto in Astrology: Power • Depth • Regeneration
subtitle: Domicile: Scorpio (modern) • Traditional Scorpio ruler: Mars • Exaltation: no broad consensus
summary: Pluto governs transformation, power, and the unconscious, exposing what must end so something truer can be reborn. Its transits and aspects trigger deep psychological purges, endings, and regeneration, often through crises that force evolutionary growth. As a slow-moving generational planet, Pluto marks collective shifts in power structures, taboo themes, and systemic breakdowns and renewals. In your chart, Pluto’s sign and house show where you’re called to face shadow material, reclaim agency, and master boundaries and resources.
intro:
Pluto shows how you do endings and beginnings—shadow work, power, obsession, elimination, and the clean rebirth after truth. Read it by sign, house, and aspects.

sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Pluto is your deep-clean button: the urge to cut to the bone, tell the hard truth, and rebuild trust from zero. Fed well, it’s integrity and profound healing. Misused, it hoards power, tests loyalty, and scorches the field.

✅ What it wants

  • Truth that frees, not shames
  • Boundaries with receipts
  • Repair that’s measurable

⚠️ When it struggles

  • Control as a love language
  • Tests, secrets, power games
  • Burn-it-down impatience

🧭 Feed it well

  • Cut one thing that’s clearly toxic
  • Replace it with a ritual that restores
  • Tell one brave truth with care

faqs.a: Intensity is the point—but it can be clean. Aim for truth + repair, not drama. Watch your Pluto house for where to go deep, not wide.

faqs.q: Will I have a Pluto return?
faqs.a: Personally, unlikely (≈248-year cycle). Focus on Pluto transits to your angles and personal planets—they’re the life-changers.
Plutonian links add magnetism and deep-bond tests. Great for honest intimacy; heavy if power is lopsided. Compare with their Venus , Mars , and Moon via compatibility .
